messages.ui.automarkers.status.canary_copied: Copied the external Marker 1 placement evidence test. Start the command first, then during its ten-second preparation countdown return to the game, open the marker menu, select Marker 1, and leave its reticle active. Do not move the mouse after selecting it. Click exactly once after the Marker 1 reticle visibly stops moving, within the eight-second confirmation window. The tool never synthesizes a click.
messages.ui.automarkers.status.native_canary_arme: Marker 1 is armed for this exact scene and setup. A fresh verified game request will place it; re-arm after fresh authority if needed.
messages.ui.automarkers.status.native_canary_not_: Marker 1 was not armed because fresh verified placement authority is not ready. Use the normal game marker flow to refresh authority, then try again.
